stories.headline: Dorchester Town returned to the top of the league with their 10th win in a…
stories.body: Dorchester Town returned to the top of the league with their 10th win in a row, with a 1-3 win at Sporting Club Inkberrow. They had to come from behind as Connor Stanley opened the scoring in the 21st minute, but goals from Oliver Haste in the 33rd minute, and a brace from Ethan Taylor, moving him onto eight for the campaign, sealed another three points for the Magpies.

stories.body: Weymouth are matching local rivals Dorchester along the way, remaining unbeaten, two points behind the league leaders, with a game in hand, following a routine 0-3 win at Barnstaple Town, thanks to goals from Toby Holmes, Sam Jackson and Tor Swann.

stories.headline: Swindon Supermarine dropped points as they came from behind for a 1-1 draw at home…
stories.body: Swindon Supermarine dropped points as they came from behind for a 1-1 draw at home to Falmouth Town. Luke Barner got his sixth goal of the season for Falmouth who sit seventh, before Supermarine’s Jowan Partridge followed up his first goal for the club last time out with another one this weekend.

stories.headline: Hungerford Town were reduced to eight men as they lost 1-0 at Westbury United.
stories.body: Hungerford Town were reduced to eight men as they lost 1-0 at Westbury United. Eben Mortimer-Taylor got the only goal of the game in the 95th minute, whilst Hungerford had Kyle Bailey sent off in the 44th minute for conceding a penalty which was saved by Ryan Clarke, Sheldon Wright dismissed in the 54th after a melee, and Jordan Graham shown red in the 99th minute for dissent, with Hungerford also having two staff members sent off.

stories.headline: Westbury climb to fifth with the win.
stories.body: Westbury climb to fifth with the win. Bishops Cleeve are now four without a win, including three losses, after they were beaten 2-3 by 17th placed Bideford.

stories.body: Ross Langworthy had Cleeve back in the lead before half-time, but a 68th minute Jordan Ewing penalty and an 80th minute Farren Simons winner sealed the three points for the Robins.
